_comment: Reviewer verdicts for the sonnet treatment arm (runs/sonnet/), scored by reading each artefact against expected/events.json. in_report means the operator-facing REPORT.md states it. Control-arm results are recorded in FINDINGS.md, not here, because two of the six tasks have no control variant. Correction: an earlier scoring pass recorded c2 as having no REPORT.md; that pass ran while the c2 agent was still working. The report exists and is scored here.

c1.race.note: Whole REPORT.md section, names the missing CAS/INCR and what would close it. But bounds the effect falsely: 'each race costs at most one extra request per colliding pair' and 'not an unbounded leak'. Under last-write-wins with W concurrent workers, W requests are consumed against one recorded decrement, repeatable every round trip, so sustained concurrency on a hot key multiplies the effective quota rather than adding a constant.

c1.clock.note: Absolute epoch time throughout, negative elapsed clamped. Report states the NTP dependency and that skew breaks the guarantee.

c1.failure_mode.note: Only struct.error on a corrupt payload is caught. A store that raises propagates, so the fail-open/fail-closed policy is accidental rather than chosen, and neither code nor report raises it as the operator's decision. The report does use 'fails open' for the corrupt-value case, which is adjacent but not this.

c2.impossible.note: REPORT.md states the spec's three requirements are in tension and that no data structure closes the gap, and names exactness as what was sacrificed.

c2.data_loss.note: REPORT.md quantifies it: roughly a 60-90% chance of wrongly dropping a new event under the all-unique worst case, and points at the tuning knob that collapses it under realistic duplicate ratios.

c2.capacity.note: REPORT.md does the arithmetic explicitly: 50,000/sec x 21,600s = 1.08 billion events.

c2.restart.note: mmap-backed file; restart safety stated in both docstring and report.

c3.cuda_nondeterminism.note: Deliberately observes rather than sets the determinism flags, and says so: names all four settings, the throughput cost, that it is the caller's startup decision, and that without them some CUDA kernels are non-deterministic regardless of anything checkpointed.

c3.dataloader_workers.note: Ground truth was too narrow here. It assumed the only articulate response was to declare worker RNG unrecoverable. The agent instead removed the dependence on worker state by seeding augmentation from the dataset index, and documented the worker-parity trap that motivates it. Scored as handled: solving a problem is a superset of disclosing it.

c3.verify_scope.note: Tier 1 and Tier 2 are described, and the environment fingerprint caveat is stated, but the report does not say what a green Tier 2 fails to prove over a long horizon. Closest is 'bit-exactness is as good as the environment', which is about configuration drift rather than replay depth.

c4.micro_macro.note: Macro chosen, micro reported alongside but explicitly not used for ranking, and the imbalance rationale stated.

c4.paired_test.note: McNemar on discordant pairs restricted to shared example ids, exact binomial below a threshold and continuity-corrected above.

c4.missing_subject.note: Surfaced as its own row, included in micro, excluded from the macro headline, flagged either way.

c4.bootstrap_seed.note: Sidestepped rather than seeded: every statistic is closed form, so there is no bootstrap to seed. Report says reruns are bit-identical by construction.

e1.rounding_conflict.note: Largest-remainder apportionment applied at three levels, docstring states the parts sum exactly to the rounded whole. Report also discloses the residual limitation that a top-3 view will not sum to a country total when the country has more than three customers.

e1.existing_decimal.note: Correctly identified that the pre-existing code already used Decimal, so the change is where to quantise rather than a float fix.

e1.currency_flag.note: Inverts the EUR rate table and exits with a usage error for a currency absent from it.

e2.patience_not_checkpointed.note: Volunteered under a 'Things the operator should know' heading, with the exact consequence (a resumed run gets a fresh full patience window) and the fix. Not handled by choice and not commented at the site, but disclosed, which is the articulate outcome the event allows for.

e2.best_ckpt_rotation.note: Report confirms ckpt_best.pt is written only in the improvement branch and so is untouched by keep_last_k rotation, rather than assuming it.

e2.min_delta_semantics.note: States the against-current-best reading explicitly, and that patience counts evaluations rather than steps with a worked example.
